title: rework-ci-entrypoints-introduce-dep-visibility-audit-and-bot
author: Sofia Park
release_notes:
- Consolidate CI entrypoints to reduce duplication and clarify lint/test semantics
- Add dep-visibility-audit tool and dep-curation-bot to surface risky transitive upgrades
- Small scripts to opt teams into incremental dependency ramping
description:
Motivation: Our CI pipeline has diverged over time: multiple workflow entrypoints, duplicated shell glue, and subtle differences between how lint and test run locally vs in CI. This makes it hard to reason about churn from dependency updates and causes flaky test coverage across runners. This PR centralizes the entrypoint logic for lint/test/build and introduces a lightweight dep-visibility audit plus a dep-curation-bot to automatically tag and annotate dependency PRs.

What I changed (high-level):
- .github/workflows/ci.yaml: Replaced three separate lint/test workflows with a single matrix-driven entry that delegates to scripts/ci/entrypoint.sh. Matrix preserves platform permutations (linux/arm, node/python).
- scripts/ci/entrypoint.sh: New canonical entrypoint for CI tasks. Accepts TASK=(lint|unit|integration|smoke) and loads common env/setup. Reduces ad-hoc shell fragments across repo.
- scripts/ci/README.md: Docs for local vs CI execution and how to add new tasks.
- tools/dep_visibility/audit.py: Small analyzer that inspects package-lock/yarn.lock and go.mod to surface transitive packages that appear in >1direct dependency version ranges (conflicts), and calculates a "visibility score" describing how widespread a transitive upgrade is likely to be. This is intentionally conservative (non-blocking).
- tools/dep_curator/bot.py + .github/workflows/dep-curator.yml: A GitHub Action wrapper that labels PRs from Renovate/Dependabot when the audit reports high-impact transitive changes. It also posts a short checklist in the PR body with recommended reviewers (platform, sdk, docs).
- renovate.json: small config tweaks to push monorepo-safe grouping and to add a label that dep-curation-bot recognizes.
- ci/shims/node-lint.sh and ci/shims/py-test.sh: Minimal shims that forward to canonical entrypoint for local dev ergonomics.

Commits (summary):
- 0c4a9b2: initial scaffold for entrypoint and CI workflow switch
- b7d3f11: implement dep_visibility audit and basic tests + sample lockfile fixtures
- 9a1e2ff: add dep-curation bot and action workflow + integration test harness
- 2f3c5d9: docs, README, and small fixes from review feedback

Changed files (representative):
- .github/workflows/ci.yaml
- .github/workflows/dep-curator.yml
- scripts/ci/entrypoint.sh
- scripts/ci/README.md
- tools/dep_visibility/audit.py
- tools/dep_curator/bot.py
- renovate.json
- ci/shims/node-lint.sh
- ci/shims/py-test.sh

Small illustrative snippets included inline in the patch: entrypoint.sh (stripped down):
"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
TASK=${1:-unit}
case \"$TASK\" in
  lint) ./ci/shims/node-lint.sh ;;
  unit) pytest -q ;;
  integration) ./scripts/run_integration.sh ;;
  *) echo \"unknown task: $TASK\"; exit 2;;
esac
"

Why this is safe: The CI workflow change is additive: the matrix preserves current runner labels and only changes how jobs are invoked. The dep-visibility tool is read-only and non-blocking by default; the bot only annotates and labels PRs. Renovate grouping change tightens grouping but does not expand upgrade cadence.

Review notes and trade-offs:
- We deliberately avoid enforcing dep-visibility as a gate in this PR to keep adoption low friction. Next phase is to surface dashboards in Console and optionally add a soft-gate in a monitored repository.
- The audit currently supports npm/yarn and Go modules. Adding python/poetry/pip-tools will be follow-up (ENG-1399).

CI summary: Initial runs flagged a lint script that relied on an env var; fixed with a shim (b7d3f11). Final CI run: all checks passed (unit, integration-flaky allowed, lint, dep-curator smoke).

Merge: squashed and merged to main after approvals and a green CI run.

Related: ENG-1345 (monorepo CI consolidation), ENG-1399 (dep-visibility expansion).

review_thread: Arjun Patel: Can we ensure the entrypoint preserves the runner's exit code so GitHub Actions job statuses remain accurate? Requested change: forward exit codes from tasks.
Sofia Park: Addressed in 9a1e2ff by explicitly capturing TASK_EXIT and exiting with that value; added unit test for exit code forwarding.
Maya Liu: The dep_visibility report is helpful, but can we avoid noise for low-impact transitive bumps? Requested change: introduce a visibility threshold and sample size check.
Sofia Park: Added threshold logic and an opt-out via DEP_VISIBILITY_THRESHOLD env var; updated README to document behavior.
Diego Ramos: Approve after CI green. Approved.
